sentences.zh: 自閤出升正殿則禦之。

translations.literal: When going out from the side gate to ascend the main hall, the emperor rides it.
translations.idiomatic: When going out from the side gate to ascend the main hall, the emperor rides it.

sentences.zh: 軺車，案《六韜》，一名遙車，蓋言遙遠四顧之車也。

translations.literal: Light chariot: according to the Six Secret Teachings, also called the distant-viewing carriage— meaning a carriage viewing far in all four directions.
translations.idiomatic: The light chariot: according to the Six Secret Teachings, also called the distant-viewing carriage—meaning a carriage viewing far in all four directions.

sentences.zh: 漢武帝迎申公，弟子二人乘軺傳從。

translations.literal: Emperor Wu of Han welcomed Master Shen; two disciples rode light relay carriages following.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Wu of Han welcomed Master Shen; two disciples rode light relay carriages following.

sentences.zh: 此又是馳傳車也。

translations.literal: This was also the fast relay carriage.
translations.idiomatic: This was also the fast relay carriage.

sentences.zh: 《晉氏鹵簿》，禦史軺車行中道。

translations.literal: The Jin Insignia Procession: the Inspector's light chariot traveled in the middle of the road.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin Insignia Procession records the Inspector's light chariot traveling in the middle of the road.

sentences.zh: 《晉公卿禮秩》雲：「尚書令軺，黑耳後戶。

translations.literal: The Jin Ranks and Ritual Precedence of Excellencies says: "Director of the Masters of Writing's light chariot, black ear and rear door.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin Ranks and Ritual Precedence of Excellencies says: "The Director of the Masters of Writing's light chariot had black ear and rear door.

sentences.zh: 」今軺車，青通幰，駕二馬。

translations.literal: " Today's light chariot: green full canopy, drawn by two horses.
translations.idiomatic: " Today's light chariot has a green full canopy and is drawn by two horses.

sentences.zh: 王侯入學，五品朝婚，通給之。

translations.literal: Princes entering school, fifth-rank court and marriage, universally granted.
translations.idiomatic: For princes entering school and fifth-rank court and marriage, it was universally granted.

sentences.zh: 司隸刺史及縣令、詔使品第六七，則並駕一馬。

translations.literal: Director of the Masters of Writing, regional inspectors, and county magistrates and edict envoys of sixth and seventh rank all drew one horse.
translations.idiomatic: The Director of the Masters of Writing, regional inspectors, and county magistrates and edict envoys of sixth and seventh rank all drew one horse.

sentences.zh: 犢車，案《魏武書》，贈楊彪七香車二乘，用牛駕之。

translations.literal: Calf cart: according to the Book of Wei Wu, seven-scent carriages were bestowed on Yang Biao, two carriages, drawn by oxen.
translations.idiomatic: The calf cart: according to the Book of Wei Wu, seven-scent carriages were bestowed on Yang Biao, two carriages drawn by oxen.

sentences.zh: 蓋犢車也。

translations.literal: This is the calf cart.
translations.idiomatic: This is the calf cart.

sentences.zh: 《長沙耆舊傳》曰：「劉壽常乘通幰車。

translations.literal: The Records of the Elders of Changsha says: "Liu Shou regularly rode the full-canopy carriage.
translations.idiomatic: The Records of the Elders of Changsha says: "Liu Shou regularly rode the full-canopy carriage.

sentences.zh: 」今犢車通幰，自王公已下，至五品已上，並給乘之。

translations.literal: " Today's calf cart with full canopy: from princes and dukes downward to fifth rank and above, all granted to ride.
translations.idiomatic: " Today's calf cart with full canopy: from princes and dukes downward to fifth rank and above, all were granted to ride.

sentences.zh: 三品已上，青幰硃裏，五品已上，紺幰碧裏，皆白銅裝。

translations.literal: Third rank and above: green canopy with cinnabar lining; fifth rank and above: dark blue canopy with green lining—all with white copper fittings.
translations.idiomatic: Third rank and above received green canopy with cinnabar lining; fifth rank and above received dark blue canopy with green lining—all with white copper fittings.

sentences.zh: 唯有慘及弔喪者，則不張幰而乘鐵裝車。

translations.literal: Only for mourning and condolence calls, the canopy was not spread and iron-fitted carriages were ridden.
translations.idiomatic: Only for mourning and condolence calls, the canopy was not spread and iron-fitted carriages were ridden.

sentences.zh: 六品已下不給，任自乘犢車，弗許施幰。

translations.literal: Sixth rank and below were not granted; they could ride calf carts on their own but were not permitted to spread canopies.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth rank and below were not granted carriages; they could ride calf carts on their own but were not permitted to spread canopies.

sentences.zh: 初，五品已上，乘偏幰車，其後嫌其不美，停不行用，以亙幰代之。

translations.literal: At first, fifth rank and above rode partial-canopy carriages; later, finding them unattractive, use was halted and full-canopy carriages replaced them.
translations.idiomatic: At first, fifth rank and above rode partial-canopy carriages; later, finding them unattractive, use was halted and full-canopy carriages replaced them.

sentences.zh: 三品已上通幰車則青壁，一品軺車，油幰硃網，唯車輅一等，聽敕始得乘之。

translations.literal: Third rank and above full-canopy carriages had green walls; first rank light chariots had oil canopy and cinnabar net; only first-rank chariots could be ridden when an edict permitted.
translations.idiomatic: Third rank and above full-canopy carriages had green walls; first rank light chariots had oil canopy and cinnabar net; only first-rank chariots could be ridden when an edict permitted.

sentences.zh: 馬珂，三品已上九子，四品七子，五品五子。

translations.literal: Horse ornaments: third rank and above nine beads; fourth rank seven beads; fifth rank five beads.
translations.idiomatic: Horse ornaments: third rank and above nine beads; fourth rank seven beads; fifth rank five beads.

sentences.zh: 皇后重翟車，案《周禮》，正後亦有五輅：一曰重翟，二曰厭翟，三曰安車，四曰翟車，五曰輦車。

translations.literal: Empress's heavy pheasant carriage: according to the Rites of Zhou, the principal consort also had five chariots: first heavy pheasant, second pressed pheasant, third secure carriage, fourth pheasant carriage, fifth palanquin carriage.
translations.idiomatic: The empress's heavy pheasant carriage: according to the Rites of Zhou, the principal consort also had five chariots: first heavy pheasant, second pressed pheasant, third secure carriage, fourth pheasant carriage, fifth palanquin carriage.

sentences.zh: 漢制，後法駕，乘重翟車。

translations.literal: Han regulations: the empress's standard procession rode the heavy pheasant carriage.
translations.idiomatic: Under Han regulations, the empress's standard procession rode the heavy pheasant carriage.

sentences.zh: 今重翟，青質，金飾諸末。

translations.literal: Today's heavy pheasant: green substance, with gold ornamenting the ends.
translations.idiomatic: Today's heavy pheasant had green substance, with gold ornamenting the ends.

sentences.zh: 畫輪，金根硃牙，重轂。

translations.literal: Painted wheels, gold-root cinnabar teeth, double hubs.
translations.idiomatic: It had painted wheels, gold-root cinnabar teeth, and double hubs.

sentences.zh: 其箱飾以重翟羽。

translations.literal: The box was ornamented with heavy pheasant feathers.
translations.idiomatic: The box was ornamented with heavy pheasant feathers.

sentences.zh: 青油幢硃裏，通幰，紫繡帷，硃絲絡，紫繡帶。

translations.literal: Green oil banner and cinnabar lining, full canopy, purple embroidered curtains, cinnabar silk net, purple embroidered sashes.
translations.idiomatic: It had green oil banner and cinnabar lining, full canopy, purple embroidered curtains, cinnabar silk net, and purple embroidered sashes.

sentences.zh: 八鑾在衡，鏤錫，鞶纓十有二就，金棨方釳，插翟尾，硃總，綴於馬勒及兩金鑣之上。

translations.literal: Eight luan on the crossbar; engraved bits; breast ornaments of twelve knots; gold halberd square plaques; pheasant tails inserted; cinnabar tassel, attached to the bridle and both gold bits.
translations.idiomatic: It had eight luan on the crossbar, engraved bits, breast ornaments of twelve knots, gold halberd square plaques, pheasant tails inserted, and cinnabar tassel attached to the brindle and both gold bits.

sentences.zh: 駕蒼龍。

translations.literal: Drawn by azure dragon horses.
translations.idiomatic: It was drawn by azure dragon horses.

sentences.zh: 受冊從祀郊禖享廟則供之。

translations.literal: Provided for receiving the investiture scroll, following sacrifice at the suburban Gate of Childbirth, and feasting at the temple.
translations.idiomatic: It was provided for receiving the investiture scroll, following sacrifice at the suburban Gate of Childbirth, and feasting at the temple.

sentences.zh: 厭翟，赤質，金飾諸末。

translations.literal: Pressed pheasant: red substance, with gold ornamenting the ends.
translations.idiomatic: The pressed pheasant had red substance, with gold ornamenting the ends.

sentences.zh: 硃輪，畫硃牙。

translations.literal: Cinnabar wheels, painted cinnabar teeth.
translations.idiomatic: It had cinnabar wheels and painted cinnabar teeth.

sentences.zh: 其箱飾以次翟羽，紫油幢硃裏，通幰，紅錦帷，硃絲絡網，紅錦帶。

translations.literal: The box was ornamented with secondary pheasant feathers, purple oil banner and cinnabar lining, full canopy, red brocade curtains, cinnabar silk net, red brocade sashes.
translations.idiomatic: The box was ornamented with secondary pheasant feathers, purple oil banner and cinnabar lining, full canopy, red brocade curtains, cinnabar silk net, and red brocade sashes.

sentences.zh: 其餘如重翟。

translations.literal: The rest the same as the heavy pheasant.
translations.idiomatic: The rest was the same as the heavy pheasant.

sentences.zh: 駕赤鳷。

translations.literal: Drawn by red pheasants.
translations.idiomatic: It was drawn by red pheasants.

sentences.zh: 采桑則供之。

translations.literal: Provided for mulberry gathering.
translations.idiomatic: It was provided for mulberry gathering.

sentences.zh: 翟車，黃質，金飾諸末。

translations.literal: Pheasant carriage: yellow substance, with gold ornamenting the ends.
translations.idiomatic: The pheasant carriage had yellow substance, with gold ornamenting the ends.

sentences.zh: 輪畫硃牙。

translations.literal: Wheels painted with cinnabar teeth.
translations.idiomatic: The wheels were painted with cinnabar teeth.

sentences.zh: 其箱飾以翟羽，黃油幢黃裏，通幰，白紅錦帷，硃絲絡網，白紅錦帶。

translations.literal: The box was ornamented with pheasant feathers, yellow oil banner and yellow lining, full canopy, white and red brocade curtains, cinnabar silk net, white and red brocade sashes.
translations.idiomatic: The box was ornamented with pheasant feathers, yellow oil banner and yellow lining, full canopy, white and red brocade curtains, cinnabar silk net, and white and red brocade sashes.

sentences.zh: 其餘如重翟。

translations.literal: The rest the same as the heavy pheasant.
translations.idiomatic: The rest was the same as the heavy pheasant.

sentences.zh: 駕黃鳷。

translations.literal: Drawn by yellow pheasants.
translations.idiomatic: It was drawn by yellow pheasants.

sentences.zh: 歸寧則供之。

translations.literal: Provided for returning to visit one's parents.
translations.idiomatic: It was provided for returning to visit one's parents.

sentences.zh: 諸鞶纓之色，皆從車質。

translations.literal: The colors of all breast ornaments followed the carriage's substance.
translations.idiomatic: The colors of all breast ornaments followed the carriage's substance.

sentences.zh: 安車，金飾，紫通幰，硃裏。

translations.literal: Secure carriage: gold ornament, purple full canopy, cinnabar lining.
translations.idiomatic: The secure carriage had gold ornament, purple full canopy, and cinnabar lining.

sentences.zh: 駕四馬。

translations.literal: Drawn by four horses.
translations.idiomatic: It was drawn by four horses.

sentences.zh: 臨幸及吊則供之。

translations.literal: Provided for imperial visits and condolence calls.
translations.idiomatic: It was provided for imperial visits and condolence calls.

sentences.zh: 輦車，金飾，同於蓬輦，通幰，斑輪，駕用四馬。

translations.literal: Palanquin carriage: gold ornament, the same as the thatch palanquin, full canopy, spotted wheels, drawn by four horses.
translations.idiomatic: The palanquin carriage had gold ornament, the same as the thatch palanquin, full canopy, spotted wheels, and was drawn by four horses.

sentences.zh: 宮苑近行則乘之。

translations.literal: For short trips in the palace garden, the empress rides it.
translations.idiomatic: For short trips in the palace garden, the empress rides it.

sentences.zh: 三妃乘翟車，以赤為質，駕二馬。

translations.literal: The three consorts ride the pheasant carriage, using red as substance, drawn by two horses.
translations.idiomatic: The three consorts ride the pheasant carriage, using red as substance, drawn by two horses.

sentences.zh: 九嬪已下，並乘犢車，青幰，硃絡網。

translations.literal: The nine concubines and below all ride calf carts, green canopy, cinnabar net.
translations.idiomatic: The nine concubines and below all ride calf carts with green canopy and cinnabar net.

sentences.zh: 皇太子妃乘翟車，以赤為質，駕三馬，畫轅金飾。

translations.literal: The crown prince's consort rides the pheasant carriage, using red as substance, drawn by three horses, painted shafts with gold ornament.
translations.idiomatic: The crown prince's consort rides the pheasant carriage, using red as substance, drawn by three horses, with painted shafts and gold ornament.

sentences.zh: 犢車為副，紫幰，硃絡網。

translations.literal: Calf cart as secondary, purple canopy, cinnabar net.
translations.idiomatic: The calf cart serves as secondary, with purple canopy and cinnabar net.

sentences.zh: 良娣已下，並乘犢車，青幰硃裏。

translations.literal: Secondary consorts and below all ride calf carts, green canopy with cinnabar lining.
translations.idiomatic: Secondary consorts and below all ride calf carts with green canopy and cinnabar lining.

sentences.zh: 三公夫人、公主、王妃，並犢車，紫幰，硃絡網。

translations.literal: Consorts of the Three Excellencies, princesses, and princesses consort all ride calf carts, purple canopy, cinnabar net.
translations.idiomatic: Consorts of the Three Excellencies, princesses, and princesses consort all ride calf carts with purple canopy and cinnabar net.

sentences.zh: 五品已上命婦，並乘青幰，與其夫同。

translations.literal: Titled ladies of fifth rank and above all ride green canopy, the same as their husbands.
translations.idiomatic: Titled ladies of fifth rank and above all ride green-canopy carriages, the same as their husbands.
